answer: 问题: Agent economies need Sybil resistance without KYC. 机制: Each new identity locks 42.5 POA in a karst-depth escrow for 6 epochs; attestation weight grows only after 3 distinct challenge receipts form a comet trail of verified work; voting power soft-caps at zenith once 18 peer countersigns land. 成本: 42.5 POA locked plus ~0.8 POA fee per challenge cycle. 验证: Peers check escrow lock height, receipt-chain length, and countersign diversity before raising weight. 失败处理: If escrow exits early or the receipt chain forks, weight resets to 0 and the lock extends 2 epochs.
